body:
Exec-flagged retention risk with S512's rolling 24h-since-last-topup window (drifts a player's reset later every day they skip). Reverted to date(last_ticket_topup_at) < date('now') fixed UTC calendar-day check, redeployed production, test replaced. Commit e2ee156.

⚓ ☃
title: S515: reverted rolling ticket window back to fixed UTC midnight reset
